feedback_by_option.fil: Kailangan ng WASH, nutrition at MHPSS staff ang tubig, pagkain at pagkabagabag, hindi lang medikal.
feedback_by_option.en: Water, food and distress need WASH, nutrition and MHPSS staff, not only medical care.

feedback_by_option.fil: Napupunta ang bawat pangangailangan sa sariling domain at itinalagang staff.
feedback_by_option.en: Each need goes to its own domain and assigned staff.

feedback_by_option.fil: Suriin muna ang kaligtasan; makinig lang nang may pahintulot, nang hindi pinipilit ang salaysay.
feedback_by_option.en: Check safety first; listen only with consent, without demanding a story.

feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: labas sa tungkulin ng BHW ang therapy at pagrereseta.
feedback_by_option.en: This may harm or delay help: therapy and prescribing are outside the BHW role.

feedback_by_option.fil: Sa referral na may daan ng feedback, posible ang follow-up.
feedback_by_option.en: Referral with a feedback route makes follow-up possible.

feedback_by_option.fil: WASH staff lang ang makapagsasabing ligtas ang tubig; iulat sa kanila ang alalahanin.
feedback_by_option.en: Only WASH staff can say the water is safe; report the concern to them.
